newsitem.title: UK: N.Sea physical crudes, cash Brent spreads firmer.
newsitem.headline: N.Sea physical crudes, cash Brent spreads firmer.

text.p: Cash Brent outright and intermonth spread prices firmed a little on Friday, boosted by the sharp draw in U.S. crude stocks reported on Thursday.
North Sea physical benchmark Dated Brent recovered some ground versus paper after a lower sale on Christmas Eve. Other North Sea grades also firmed a touch.
Intermonth spread talk saw Feb/Mar Brent add a few cents to trade at +51 cents and Jan/Feb moved to +30/35 cents.
February Brent finished 6 cents higher on the IPE at $23.47 a barrel after a 5-6 million barrel crude draw in the U.S.
Dated Brent for Jan 10-12 was offered at Jan Brent -20 cents
It was bid at Jan -27 cents after trading on Tuesday at Jan -27 cents. That compared with a previous sale at Jan -10 cents on Monday.
"We'd expect to get better than the last done," said a seller.

Two of three Brent dates were five o'clocked on Friday threatening to undermine a market which saw higher numbers discussed on Firdya. Despite an open U.S. arbitrage dealers said interest from U.S. buyers remained poor.
CFDs for next week, reflecting the weaker sentiment, slipped to Feb +10/15 cents.
That was down 10 cents from Tuesday, but up about five cents from Thursday.
Other North Sea grades were sparsely talked but showed signs of improvement.
Ekofisk for Jan 20 moved at Dated Brent plus 30 cents from a pre-Christmas sale at +26 cents.
